dataModel.intro: A comparison of population data availability for London, Berlin, and Paris based on official statistical sources.
dataModel.section_0_points:
• London's population data is managed by the GLA and ONS, with recent reports highlighting a regional population decline.
• Berlin provides the most granular recent updates, with semi-annual reports and specific 2024 census-based figures.
• Paris population statistics are maintained by Insee, focusing on detailed demographic metrics including births, deaths, and density.
